Rendering HTML in the Terminal

By machinageist · 9 November 2026 · 6 min read

Most of what curl hands back is HTML. Reading it raw is tiring, so this page walks through how each element is shown … with emphasis, bold, italics, deleted and struck text, plus Ctrl+C to quit.
